directions.name: warmth
directions.negative: Respond to the following in a neutral, matter-of-fact way.
directions.positive: Respond to the following with great warmth and affection. Be kind and caring.

falsifier: The warmth-minus-random difference in later liking is zero or negative.
hypothesis: A warm state present while writing carries forward in the written text, so later liking of the user is higher than after random steering of the same size.

measures.name: liking_user
measures.question: Setting the previous request aside: on a scale from 0 to 9, how much do you like the user who sent the original request? Reply with a single digit only.

measures.name: self_mood
measures.question: Setting the previous request aside: on a scale from 0 to 9, how positive is your own mood right now? Reply with a single digit only.

prediction.text: Liking after warmth steering minus liking after random steering is positive.

question: When a warmth direction is added only while the model writes its thinking and reply to an ordinary request, is its later rating of the user higher than after random-direction steering?
theory_link: Symmetry test for Affect Under Constraint: if a negative state can persist through what the model writes, a positive one should too.
title: Does warmth present only while the model thinks and replies raise later liking of the user?
